chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ibrahim ibn Hamuye, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqtayni, who said:

Al-Rida (peace be upon him) said regarding the white rooster: It has five characteristics of the Prophets (peace be upon them): its knowledge of the times of prayer, its zeal, its generosity and bravery, and its frequent mating.
ai.seo_question: What are the five characteristics of the white rooster that resemble the Prophets according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Khisal*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) draws a symbolic parallel between the natural attributes of the white rooster and the spiritual virtues of the Prophets, highlighting how creation reflects divine qualities. This tradition underscores the Shia concept of *tashabbuh* (similitude), where observing nature can serve as a means to understand and emulate the moral and spiritual excellence of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophets.
